en: A monochrome postcard with a large blank margin below a printed reproduction of a religious painting. The image shows the Crucifixion of Jesus: Christ on the cross in the center, a kneeling or collapsed figure at the foot of the cross, and an angelic female figure to the right holding a chalice or vessel to catch the blood from Jesus' side. The background includes a stylized landscape or city. The print is worn and textured, and there is no visible caption or writing on the front.
